settings.title: Settings & Appearance
settings.subtitle: Customize Branchpad look, themes and font sizes
settings.auto_save.on: On (1 second after you stop typing)
settings.ui_font_desc: Controls the general user interface font size
settings.editor_font_desc: Font size for code editor and diff views
settings.preview_text: Branchpad: Native, lightweight Git client & editor for macOS.
settings.theme.modern_dark_desc: Clean slate background with cobalt accent
settings.theme.one_dark_desc: Classic warm charcoal with vibrant syntax
settings.theme.nord_desc: Arctic ice tones, elegant and soothing
settings.theme.tokyo_night_desc: Modern deep violet cyber night palette
settings.theme.modern_light_desc: Crisp white minimalist with high contrast
settings.theme.warm_paper_desc: Cozy sepia paper tone for daytime comfort
settings.agent.inputs_hint: Left: path to the CLI (empty = find automatically). Right: model (empty = the CLI's default).
settings.agent.worktree_desc: Off: the AI edits the files of your working folder. On: each new session works on a new ai/… branch in <repo>-worktrees/ (from HEAD, without your uncommitted changes); open it with “Open worktree” to review and merge.
settings.agent.shell_desc: Claude may run commands (tests, builds) without asking. Codex always runs commands in its sandbox (writes only inside the repo, no network).
